abilities.name: Seek Bloodshed
abilities.text: When the Current Supply Value of another Friendly Unit Within 12″ of this Unit is reduced, this Unit, if Unengaged, may perform a Move action Directly Towards that Friendly Unit.

abilities.name: Bloodshard Blink
abilities.text: Immediately before this Unit resolves any PLACE effect, you may target one Enemy Unit. This Unit's weapons gain BUFF RoA (1) against the targeted Unit, but this Unit must perform PLACE Directly Towards the chosen Unit.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.text: Resolve the PLACE (6) effect. Models set by this effect cannot be set up Within the Engagement Range of any Enemy Unit.
